status_legend.ADMITTED_PRIMITIVE: posited as an input of the programme, not derived
status_legend.DEFINITION: a definition in the cited source
status_legend.PROVED_PROSE: a prose proof in the cited source; no Lean artifact
status_legend.PROVED_LEAN: a named Lean declaration exists in the checkout and the source cites it; elaboration was not re-run here
status_legend.COMPUTATIONALLY_CHECKED: an exact finite computation or Rust/Python control; not a proof for the general statement
status_legend.CONDITIONAL: holds under a stated hypothesis that the source does not discharge
status_legend.IMPORTED_ASSUMPTION: structure supplied from outside the derivation and named as such
status_legend.OPEN: unproved, unwritten, or a proposal whose pull request is not merged
status_legend.SOURCE_RECORD: a step the cited source records, or a fence label from a TFQ source slice; the DAG assigns it no derivation status

edge_semantics: A route requires all of its inputs and yields its output.
Routes with the same output are alternatives.
GAP_NO_DERIVATION marks a join that the sources assert but do not derive; it carries no source.
CONDITIONAL_ON_IMPORT marks a join that holds once the named imported structure is supplied.
see_also on a node lists nodes from other segments that cover the same question under a different source.
RECORD_PARENT marks the TFQ tree link from a record to its parent record; it asserts reading order, not a derivation.
non_discharge_notes: <> is an inert inscription in the Pre-Genesis and Genesis papers. The admitted root Difference joined with Structure is defined elsewhere. No source derives the second from the first, and the DAG keeps them as two nodes joined by a gap.
No source read derives the l1 sector weights from the Phi1 and Gamma2 residual. Weights enter as declared mass.

The lift from L1 to a Hilbert space imports a complex field, U(1) phases, an inner product, orthogonal additivity, independent Haar phases and linear isometric dynamics. Only the finite matrix algebra over Gaussian integers is recovered.
Nodes tagged proposed-pr-open are proposals in draft pull requests. They are not proved on main.
A PROVED_LEAN status means a named declaration exists and a source cites it. Receipts, hashes and ledger flags were not treated as proof.

schema_notes: derivation_dag.v2 makes this file the single source of the derivation graph. Besides nodes and routes it holds records, every TFQ record of the derivation tree in reading order, and index_document, the hand-authored text of the Markdown index.

theory_of_finite_qm.jsonl and theory_of_finite_qm.md are generated, read-only views rendered from this file by dag/render_dag_views.py: one JSONL line per record (sorted keys, CRLF) and the Markdown index. Never edit them by hand; dag/validate_derivation_dag.py fails when a view on disk differs from the renderer.

A record has the fields coda_atlas_ids, coda_atlas_paths, existing_derivation_dag_ids, f004_refs, id, lean4, local_id, name, obligation, parent_id, python, record_status, rust, source_slice, stage, summary and uuid, and optionally pfp_review_refs. parent_id is null only for the root record TFQ-0000. Every record names at least one node in existing_derivation_dag_ids and every node is named by at least one record.

Ownership: records of source_slice unified_dag, application_branches, pregenesis_to_wdp, frontier_branches and genesis_to_higher, and the pfp_review_refs of the other records, are written by dag/sync_unified_dag.py, dag/sync_application_branches.py, dag/sync_pregenesis_to_wdp.py, dag/sync_frontier_branches.py, dag/sync_genesis_to_higher.py and dag/sync_pfp_results.py from their fragments; the other records are edited here. index_document.application_stages is written by dag/sync_application_branches.py (application stages) and dag/sync_frontier_branches.py (frontier stages) and dag/sync_genesis_to_higher.py (the genesis-to-higher stage), and index_document.source_corpus_restatements by dag/sync_unified_dag.py; header_markdown, record_count_note, stage_index and coda_atlas_packages are edited here.

Run order: sync_pfp_results.py, sync_unified_dag.py, sync_application_branches.py, sync_pregenesis_to_wdp.py, sync_frontier_branches.py, sync_genesis_to_higher.py; each writes this file and then the two views. After a hand edit of this file, run dag/render_dag_views.py --write.

A source outside this repository is cited by marker, not by path: external:sha256:<hex> is the SHA-256 of the cited file's bytes, external:git-tree:<oid> the git tree id of a cited directory, and external:unlocated a citation whose file could not be found. A line range, ::symbol or #anchor after the marker is the original locator within that source. Nothing behind a marker counts as in-repository evidence.

nodes.statement: Admitted root of the programme: Real_0 = PrimitiveDifference ⊔ Structure, a typed coproduct of two independently posited channels. As a type construction (arbitrary payload types, same two-constructor shape as OntologyBasic.Real0) the coproduct is a categorical coproduct that singles out no map between the channels and supplies no element of either; the existence of a map out of it that is the identity on one channel holds exactly when that channel is nonempty or the other is empty, so for inhabited channels (as the real record types are) bare function-existence is not a no-reduction theorem. nodes.statement: WDP-CH07-D01: a finite duration gauge is a path system with an additive edge valuation λ: E → M into a commutative monoid, D_λ(p) = Σ_j λ(e_j); positivity, Archimedean structure, units and real values are extra hypotheses, and WDP-CH07-P01 gives D_λ(pq) = D_λ(p) + D_λ(q) whenever pq is defined. WDP-CH07-P02: if λ = d₀t, every directed path from a to b has duration t(b) − t(a). The converse needs more than weak connectedness: a base vertex reaching every vertex with path-independent sums, or vanishing periods under signed walks; the difference of two path sums with common endpoints is a period witness, and a nonzero period refutes exactness.

nodes.source_status: docs/genesis_to_wdp_derivation_programme.md §4 and register GEN-WDP-07 (conditional, fixed carrier); bridge to the window owed
nodes.statement: GEN-WDP-07, a conditional theorem in the bridge register, fixes a carrier and marked triples F, keeps the full directed integer table e(x, y) = M_r(x, y) − M_s(x, y) including loops and independent reverse arcs, treats raising as e ↦ e + d₀g with (d₀g)(x, y) = g(x) − g(y), and uses the marked diagnostic D_F(e)(x, y, z) = e(x, y) + e(y, z) + e(z, x). Cancellation gives D_F d₀ = 0, so D_F(e + d₀g) = D_F e even for unbalanced triples, and rationalizing reflects integer repair equality. This is a repair quotient with descending reports, not automatically cohomology: C¹/im d₀ differs from ker D_F/im d₀, a filled mark may be unbalanced, triangle reports miss loops and two-way defects, and antisymmetric simplicial coordinates need e(x, x) = 0 and e(x, y) + e(y, x) = 0. records.summary: WDP-CH01-P02: for a pointed relation (X, R, a, b) on a finite carrier, R(a,b) does not imply a ≠ b (one-point carrier with R = {(a,a)} and b = a), a ≠ b does not imply R(a,b) (the empty relation on two points), and R(a,b) with R irreflexive implies a ≠ b, since a = b would give R(a,a). Irreflexivity is therefore a declared ingredient of the admitted package, not a consequence of relatedness, and a carrier hosting an irreflexive related pair has at least two elements; PrimDiff.lean states the same endpoint fact for an irreflexive witness. The Python census over every pointed relation on carriers of size 1 to 3 counts 4674 relations, 2337 with R(a,b), 196 with R(a,b) and R irreflexive, 3104 with a ≠ b, and none with R irreflexive, R(a,b) and a = b.

Section 7.2 keeps four statuses apart: exact (a displayed t with d₀t = λ), closed nonexact (d₁λ = 0 for a declared d₁ while a period or dual certificate shows λ ∉ im d₀), active closure failure (d₁λ ≠ 0 on an exhibited 2-cell) and exactness undetermined. WDP-CH07-P02: if λ = d₀t, every directed path from a to b has duration t(b) − t(a). The converse needs more than weak connectedness: a base vertex reaching every vertex with path-independent sums, or vanishing periods under signed walks; the difference of two path sums with common endpoints is a period witness, and a nonzero period refutes exactness.

Cancellation gives D_F d₀ = 0, so D_F(e + d₀g) = D_F e even for unbalanced triples, and rationalizing reflects integer repair equality. This is a repair quotient with descending reports, not automatically cohomology: C¹/im d₀ differs from ker D_F/im d₀, a filled mark may be unbalanced, triangle reports miss loops and two-way defects, and antisymmetric simplicial coordinates need e(x, x) = 0 and e(x, y) + e(y, x) = 0.
